whenToUse: Reviews after a purchase or visit.
A star rating alone doesn't say why.
whenNotToUse: Quick satisfaction surveys (use an emoji rating).
Designs that block the button until people write.
Making a review mandatory to move on.

alternatives.name: Rating Tags
alternatives.reason: Collecting reasons as chips instead of text.

accessibility: The rating is a group of radio buttons, and a missing rating's error is connected to the fieldset.
The text field ties its rules and character count with aria-describedby.
On submit, focus moves to the first problem.
The button can always be pressed, so it tells people what's missing.
